stories.new_fact: Freddie Mac reported $98 billion of single-family new business and that 6 percent of acquired loans were assessed with VantageScore 4.0 for pricing after seller availability expanded in September.

stories.why_now: This is a new primary quarterly usage disclosure dated October 29.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered delinquent-loan sales and rate movement, not this usage signal and score-path workflow.
stories.uncertainty: Freddie gives no borrower savings, approval-rate, loss, or lender-adoption baseline.
stories.watch: Later score-path adoption, pricing, and performance data.

editorial_review.notes: Four fresh stories are October 30 early-voting/rally reporting, October 29 Senate daylight-saving reporting, the effective October 31 Columbus Halloween schedule, and October 29 Freddie Mac quarterly score-usage disclosure.
